title: Ask for some space
subtitle: A short, kind message. Your partner sees only what you write.

presets(map).space: I need some time to breathe. I'll be back soon.
presets(map).calm: I want to listen well. I need to calm down first.

note: You both see Today on pause. You can come back whenever you like.
sentText: Today is on pause for both of you. When you're ready, come back there.

errors(map).INVALID_RETURN_TIME: That return time doesn't work. Pick another.
errors(map).RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a moment.
errors(map).other: Couldn't send right now. Your message is still here.
